high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Bloomberg.com, viewed on Instagram. The content discusses the involvement of LVMH (LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton), a luxury goods company, with the Olympics. The text highlights how Arnault, the CEO of LVMH, is sponsoring the Olympics to avoid condemnation and foster goodwill. It mentions that LVMH brands are involved in various aspects of the event, such as designing medals, dressing French athletes for the opening ceremony, and supplying Moët & Chandon at victory celebrations.
